category_title: Middle school student with autism and language impairment exhibiting socially inappropriate communication
minimal_context: Molly is sitting with her general education reading group while they read an article about Japan, but she has been given a separate coloring worksheet to complete.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: The rest of the group is reading an article about Japan. Molly, here is a worksheet for you to color while they read.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Laughs aloud) Worksheet for you to color.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Yes, go ahead and start coloring.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Makes inappropriate noises for bodily functions while sitting next to the group)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please work quietly on your coloring.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Turns her body to look away from the instructional personnel and her collaborative general education classmates, completely ignoring the unrelated worksheet)

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: The rest of the group is reading an article about Japan. Molly, here is a worksheet for you to color while they read.

STUDENT: (Laughs aloud) Worksheet for you to color.

TUTOR: Yes, go ahead and start coloring.

STUDENT: (Makes inappropriate noises for bodily functions while sitting next to the group)

TUTOR: Please work quietly on your coloring.

STUDENT: (Turns her body to look away from the instructional personnel and her collaborative general education classmates, completely ignoring the unrelated worksheet)

task.content: Reading an article about the culture of Japan and participating in group work
task.learning_goal: Identification of letters and numbers as well as writing focused on general education content

context.materials: Age appropriate and at grade level material (e.g., an article about the culture of Japan), worksheets to color
context.social_setting: Group work with collaborative general education classmates

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When they did not participate in the class instructional activities and were given unrelated activities
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Looking away from instructional personnel or collaborative general education classmates

behavior_patterns.condition: When she occasionally would try to socialize with others
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Laughing aloud, inappropriately making noises for bodily functions, or repeating a phrase she had heard earlier
